args.text: Draft the Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team here: first report time, when kiosk 1 came back, and when both lanes were confirmed working.

Gideon Sato, here's a draft from #inc-vtg-hartford (you're a member there):

Subject: Hartford gate kiosk incident, Aug 3, 2026

Hi Mateo,

Summary of the gate check-in incident at Vantorre's Hartford plant on Monday, Aug 3, 2026 (times as shown in the incident channel; the channel doesn't state a time zone):

- First report: 10:42 AM. Both inbound lane kiosks were showing a white screen after badge scan, and the guard fell back to logging trailers by hand. Your note at 10:44 AM reported six trucks waiting at the east gate.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. You confirmed the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM. We kept the incident open for another arrival cycle to be sure.

Scope: gate check-in only. Scheduling from the dispatch office kept working throughout. Carrowmere Cloud, our hosting vendor, checked the Hartford gateway route and received the reconnect log.

Separate open item: the status-page access problem on your login (your admin account can open Pemberline Dock) is still being chased under ticket INC-4821.

Best,
Gideon

Notes: I haven't sent this to anyone. Mateo is outside pemberline.com, so any email to him needs Ruth Calloway's approval first. I left out the root cause because the channel doesn't give one.
